tools.name: merge_pdf
tools.description: Concatenate two or more PDFs into a single PDF, in the order supplied, and return the merged file. Over MCP the PDF is never inlined: it comes back as a stored URL that stays retrievable for about 24 hours. Page content is copied unchanged — it does not compress (use compress_pdf) or select pages (u

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Extract page ranges from one PDF into new PDFs. One output file is produced per range: a single range returns that PDF directly, several ranges return a ZIP containing one PDF each. Over MCP you receive a link to the stored output rather than its bytes, and that link keeps working for roughly a day.

tools.name: compress_pdf
tools.description: Shrink a PDF's byte size while keeping it a PDF, for email limits or slow connections. Returns the compressed PDF; over MCP it is never inlined, arriving as a stored URL that stays retrievable for about 24 hours. Ghostscript on razi.pro's worker downsamples embedded images at a fixed 'ebook' preset

tools.name: images_to_pdf
tools.description: Assemble pictures into one PDF, a page per picture, in the order supplied. PNG and JPEG bytes are embedded untouched; WebP, GIF, TIFF and AVIF are re-encoded to PNG on the way in, which loses no detail but does rewrite the file. tools.name: extract_text_ocr
tools.description: Use this ONLY when the text exists as PIXELS and nothing else — a photo, a screenshot, a scan. It runs optical character recognition on an image and GUESSES the characters, so it is a best-effort transcription that misreads under blur, skew or low contrast. Returns JSON { text, language, confidence?

tools.name: parse_document
tools.description: Use this when the file ALREADY stores its text as characters: it decodes them and returns JSON { text, metadata } verbatim, with no guessing involved. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "documents" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: split_pdf, parse_document · Private data: merge_pdf, split_pdf, compress_pdf, images_to_pdf, extract_text_ocr, parse_document · Public sink: merge_pdf, split_pdf, compress_pdf, images_to_pdf, extract_text_ocr, parse_document · Destructive: merge_pdf, compress_pdf, images_to_pdf, extract_text_ocr, parse_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: split_pdf, parse_document · Private data: merge_pdf, split_pdf, compress_pdf, images_to_pdf, extract_text_ocr, parse_document · Public sink: merge_pdf, split_pdf, compress_pdf, images_to_pdf, extract_text_ocr, parse_document · Destructive: merge_pdf, compress_pdf, images_to_pdf, extract_text_ocr, parse_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
